description: The bar chart illustrates the performance metrics of three models, namely (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot), across three evaluation categories: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the metric values, ranging from 40 to 100 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category contains a group of three bars, colored light blue, dark blue, and green, corresponding to the three models, respectively. For Recall, the bars have approximate values of 63.58, 71.90, and 72.29; for Precision, the values are approximately 88.89, 91.24, and 92.31; and for F1 Score, the values are around 75.34, 80.40, and 81.08. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the models are consistently ordered across the categories. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
